_readme: DOWNLOADABLE AND LINKED RESOURCES
Worksheets, lesson plans, teaching guides, revision sheets and any other file
offered on the site. Lessons that are written as ordinary pages do NOT belong
here - they are page files in _src/pages/ and are indexed automatically.
The same publishing rule applies as for past papers: add a resource only if
RCF English created it, the copyright holder has given permission, it has been
personally approved, or it is being linked from an official source.
FIELDS (only 'id', 'title' and 'type' are compulsory):
id             a short name with no spaces
title          what the visitor sees
description    one or two sentences
category       ol-english | ol-literature | general-english | al-literature |
past-papers | teacher-resources | interactive
subcategory    e.g. guided-writing, grammar, marking
subject        the subject it belongs to
level          e.g. Grade 11, A1, Advanced Level
examination    ol | al | none
type           worksheet | lesson-plan | teaching-guide | model-answer |
revision-paper | article | quiz
skill          reading | writing | listening | speaking | grammar | vocabulary
duration       for lesson plans, e.g. 40 minutes
learnerLevel   e.g. mixed ability, slow learners
author         who wrote it
updated        2026-08-26
keywords       words a visitor might search for
thumbnail      assets/img/thumbs/your-picture.png
url            downloads/your-file.pdf   OR   an official https:// address
fileSize       e.g. 320 KB
featured       true puts it in the Featured Resources area on the home page
copyright      Created by RCF English | Published with permission |
Linked from the official source
answers        address of the answer sheet, if there is one
markingScheme  address of the marking scheme, if there is one
related        ["id-of-another-resource"]
published      false hides the record without deleting it
After editing this file, run build.cmd.
